title: 履修登録を完了してください。（仮）
phase: Phase 4: elective promotion quotas increased progressively; targeted grade-gate regression completed; real mobile/Pages UI and human difficulty review pending
scope: 4 years / 8 terms playable; 3 faculties; 5 extracurricular difficulty setups
features: tap an unoccupied timetable slot to choose courses that include that period
24 additional general course definitions plus advanced faculty seminars and research
full-year courses occupy same period over 2 terms: interim spring result, 4 credits only at autumn final
grade history shows mandatory pass/fail/retake and yearlong outcomes
synthesized sound effects with persistent on/off switch
8 term score, graduation decision at 72 credits and all compulsory courses, saved progress and separate personal best

v0.4.0: student-life narrative and overall starting difficulty
v0.4.0: course completion chance weighs first period, Saturday, adjacent-period front course, weekly occupied blocks and year-level skipping
v0.4.0: simplified score = 100 points per credit plus 50 per combo tier capped at +250; activity and perfect bonuses normalized
v0.4.0: yearly credit thresholds of 16, 34, 54, 72 and stop at years 1-3 when the threshold is missed
v0.4.0: 4th-year spring recruiting disruption forces 2-3 enrolled courses to fail with an alert before grade reveal
v0.5.0: no score/combo language in tutorial, clearer deterministic-seed instructions
v0.5.0: smartphone scroll to page start on begin, resume and next term; semester text 'year, first/second semester' instead of /8
v0.5.0: full legend with required ★, electives, yearlong and extracurricular timetable colors
v0.5.0: remove opaque class/credit/occupied period count; natural-language registration summary
v0.5.0: sort course lists by availability, success odds up/down, weekday, credits or difficulty; hide obsolete search
v0.5.0: remove 14-credit hard limit, all open non-overlapping periods are registrable; severe crowding reduces all class success odds
v0.5.0: per-course score arithmetic: 100pt per earned credit plus capped additive combo; perfect and activity semester bonus explicitly broken down
v0.5.0: annual course interim results award no credits or points until autumn final
v0.5.0: extracurricular blocks increase by +1 weekly in year 2 and +2 in years 3-4; block placement deterministic per seed
v0.5.0: 4th-year autumn 45% seeded chance for a graduation trip (all class pass chances -18 percentage points); pre-grade event notice
v0.5.1/v0.5.2: failed mandatory classes become mandatory and auto-reserve their original weekday/period in the same term of the next academic year
v0.5.2: if a new required class clashes with an older retake, shift the new class to later same-day period whenever possible; later days fallback; deferral is emergency only
v0.5.2: from year 3, elective seminars / specialist lectures use another campus and switching requires one timetable slot of movement, displayed in lavender
v0.5.2: same-campus consecutive lessons do not require intermediate travel, no travel slot after fifth period
v0.5.2: consecutive lecture pairs penalize both classes, heavy teaching days and high total occupied slots penalize all courses
v0.5.2: removed artificial 10-credit minimum for registration to prevent mandatory-backlog deadlock
v0.5.3: graduation requires >=72 credits and zero failed compulsory courses; otherwise explicit GAME OVER (even with new high score)
v0.5.3: year-four spring mandatory failures receive a final automatic retake in fourth-year autumn
v0.5.3: fourth-year mandatory schedule clashes relocate current mandatory and, where necessary, extracurricular periods; no silent postponement beyond graduation
v0.6.0: disabled timetable slots that contain no currently registerable course; slot and course drawers scroll to top
v0.6.0: +5pp rest bonus when the preceding weekday is entirely free (not Monday), +4pp for repeated mandatory course
v0.6.0: prerequisite source courses display subsequent unlocked lectures
v0.6.0: all-red and excellent-semester grade specials; full passes grant a +6pp next-semester honor bonus
v0.6.0: fourth-year grade reveal offers one deterministic professor petition per non-lottery failed course, with chances based on assessment method and difficulty
v0.6.0: after successfully completing each of years 1–3, deterministic seeded random 3-card skill draft from a varied 14-skill pool, one skill permanently recorded per year

v0.6.0: stacked skills include permanent past-exam benefit, next-year 50pp cheating advantage plus 10% per-course forced-year-repeat detection, mandatory 100% pass when an immediately preceding study period is reserved, score boosting, morning/weekend study bonuses
v0.6.0: hourly wage increase reduces tutoring commitments by one period per stack; club retirement releases club periods, but loses 120pt each academic term
v0.6.0: cheating discovery ends the run as explicit GAME OVER; skill offers and cheating/petition rolls are independently deterministic given seed+term

v0.6.1: unavailable timetable slots now show the actual reason rather than a dash: candidate absent / prerequisite unmet / timetable clash / activity conflict / campus movement / mixed conditions. Long explanations appear in accessible labels and hover titles.
v0.6.2: show year-end random three-skill selection immediately when year credit target is met; full-screen panel on mobile; prevent skipping; recover pending selection on resume
v0.6.2: clarify no skill draft after year-credit gate failure, since the game ends before next academic year
v0.6.2: narrow 1-hour noon break between second and third lectures; campus changes during lunch do not occupy third period
v0.6.2: third-period courses receive +6 percentage points (98% max, compulsory preparation skill stays at 100%)
v0.6.2: large top-of-screen year/year4 graduation goal banner with confirmed credits, target, remaining credits, and unearned mandatory counts at year 4
v0.6.3: +4 percentage points to lectures immediately before unavoidable club/job commitments
v0.6.3: second-to-third-period adjacency no longer receives the -8pp consecutive lecture penalty because the one-hour lunch break separates them; first-to-second and third-to-fourth still penalized
v0.6.3: an unoccupied gap within the same weekday between consecutive lectures penalizes the later course by -6pp for one blank period or -9pp for two or more

v0.6.3: yearly skill draft no longer auto-opens immediately after final year-end grades; player reviews complete results, clicks explicit choose-skill button, then gets the full-screen random three-choice selector
v0.6.3: course details explain conditional schedule odds modifiers from activity, lunch, and empty-lesson gaps

v0.7.0: promotion gates use cumulative elective-only earned credits per faculty/academic year: humanities 8/22/38/52, economics 4/18/34/48, science 4/14/30/44; mandatory credits do not count toward those quotas
v0.7.0: graduation requires final-year elective quota plus all compulsory courses, including successful last-chance repeats
v0.7.0: earn elective credits exactly once by canonical course ID; annual electives earn no credit in interim spring evaluation and are counted at autumn final; professor petitions update the ledger

v0.7.0: registration confirmation modal precedes all grade draws, lists registered mandatory/optional classes with final pass chance and component breakdown, lets users remove/change optional courses, and supports back/confirm
v0.7.0: correct real UI onclick binding for the latest annual-skill advance handler, instead of the stale pre-wrapper advance function; same applies to grade-start so all postprocessing wrappers run

v0.7.0: skill selection triggered at end of year only after elective credit requirement met; saved ongoing sessions estimate elective credits from past mandatory grade history when migrating old saves

v0.7.1: tighten cumulative faculty-specific elective credit quotas by +2/+2/+4/+4 across academic years: humanities [10,24,42,56], economics [6,20,38,52], science [6,16,34,48]. Graduating requires fourth-year quota and all compulsory credits.

ai_audit.structure: PASS: JS bracket/quote balance; no missing DOM IDs from game.js and expansion.js (124 $ references against 57 HTML IDs)
ai_audit.placement_model: PASS: 3 faculties × 5 activity setups × 8 terms × 100 generated schedules (12,000 total) all reached the 10-credit registration threshold with no mandatory/activity collisions. Static matching model does not cover prerequisite gating, annual carry or actual browser behavior.
ai_audit.audio: Implementation only; sound not verified on real device
ai_audit.state_save_resume: Implementation only; 8-term save and recovery not verified in real browser
ai_audit.simulation: 8-term probabilistic graduation score distribution not measured
caveats: Simulated 225 routes with an automated course selection heuristic; not a human playtest.
The timetable generation results above do not establish a guaranteed 8-term graduation path for every random seed; progression failure is intentional.
Actual smartphone rendering, audio, save-and-resume and accessibility QA remain unverified.
The UI shows modeled pass probability rather than certainty. Scenario recalculates upon registration.
The homepage INDEX still lists the prior S8 version until the project master updates it.
ai_audit.activity_timetable_revision: PASS: tutoring occupies Mon4, Mon5, Fri5 (3 distinct periods); club+job occupies Mon5, Tue5, Wed5, Thu5, Sat3 (5 distinct periods), no overlaps.
ai_audit.runtime_simulation: PASS: 225 two-to-eight-term runs (3 faculties×5 activities×15 seeds) using a simulated DOM and deterministic course selection. 0 exceptions, 0 terms with insufficient registration, 0 mandatory/activity collisions, 101 ran to term 8 and 124 failed yearly progression; 101 reached job-hunt event; 49 annual starts/49 autumn continuations. This is a logic harness, not a browser test.
ai_audit.risk_rate_tests: PASS: representative test — neutral 92%, first period 78%, Saturday first period 71%, year 4 lower than year 1 by 12pp. Same seed gave identical activity slots. Score examples: 2 credits=200pt, 4 credits=400pt, two credits at 3 combo=300pt.
ai_audit.runtime_simulation_v05: PASS: 300 simulated logic playthroughs (3 faculties × 5 activities × 20 seeds), using mock DOM/automatic elective strategy. 151 reached final term, 149 failed earlier year requirements, 0 runtime errors, 0 registration deadlocks (registration <10 credits), 0 mandatory/activity collisions, 1874 semester instances registered >14 credits, activity block counts correct. Among 151 final-term plays 57 were graduation trip events and UI pending flag was set 57 times. These are not full real-browser UI tests.
ai_audit.score_mechanics_v05: 2 credits → 200 basic points; 4 credits → 400; plus +50 × min(5, combo index-1). Annual spring midterm 0, autumn passed earns 4 credits×100pt. Semester bonuses shown separately.
ai_audit.static_v05: PASS: game.js, expansion.js, balance.js, polish.js pass JS compilation; HTML DOM IDs for referenced fields present. Legacy hidden search input kept to protect expansion.js init binding.
outstanding: Real device-browser QA required: independently verify the final onclick binding actually shows the skill selector on a phone after finishing first-year fall grade results.

Human playtest elective quota sizes, especially economics/science year-one target of 4 optional credits; targets are derived by subtracting expected cumulative mandatory volume from the old combined threshold.
Potential historical save migration is an estimate, since pre-v0.7.0 history stored total credits and mandatory result IDs but no standalone elective ledger.
Risk probability breakdown includes a final cap/rounding/mobility residual after describing core contributors; confirm it is understandable in actual mobile layout.
Ensure the confirmation modal can be dismissed and class cancellation can lead naturally back to optional selection.
No changes to root INDEX, managed by project master.
ai_audit.v052_static: PASS: all 5 JavaScript bundles compile and DOM IDs referenced by scripts exist. Source-layer first boot was checked; ADVANCED IIFE private symbol access was corrected.
ai_audit.v052_firstyear_expected_credits: 750 faculty×activity×seed models for each target load: 10 registered credits -> 7.50 expected earned, 14 -> 8.79, 20 -> 7.20, approximately 30 -> 1.69. Static expected-credit analysis, not measured grade outcomes.
ai_audit.v052_mandatory: PASS: 15 faculty×activity fixed-retake probes: all 15 repeated failed mandatory courses in the original slots next academic year. New-lectures shift to later slots; none overlapped activities or fixed classes.
ai_audit.v052_runtime: PASS with balance caveat: 150 complete-path mock-DOM runs (3 faculties × 5 activities × 10 seeded scenarios): 151 automatic required time changes, 257 registered backlog retakes, 41 visible travel periods, 0 travel overlaps, 0 execution errors. Of the 150 runs, 23 reached the end and 127 failed yearly stage requirements. Five terms had <10 available/selected credits; the prior artificial minimum was removed and grade reveal proceeded. Outcomes are highly punishing, especially for activity-heavy students, and require human difficulty review.
ai_audit.v052_campus: In-term campus movement marks an available period immediately after the last lesson before a campus switch, or after the last specialist-campus lesson when it fits; adjacent cross-campus classes cannot register; no movement after fifth period.
ai_audit.v053_runtime: PASS: 300 simulated complete playthroughs across three faculties/five activities/20 seeds. 54 reached fourth-year final results, of which six graduated, 44 failed with compulsory courses outstanding and four failed on credits alone. 342 shifted compulsory placements, 57 last-chance spring-failure retakes, zero mandatory overlaps, zero activity overlaps, zero placement deferrals, zero execution errors. Difficulty is severe; this is not human testing.
ai_audit.v053_targeted: PASS: 15/15 faculty×activity seeded fourth-year-spring-failure fixtures rescheduled a mandatory retake in fourth-year autumn; 15/15 compulsory-missing conditions displayed GAME OVER at >=72 credits; 15/15 credits-plus-all-compulsories conditions displayed graduation; stress case with 30 periods forced an explicit placement failure and GAME OVER.
ai_audit.v053_static: PASS: all five JS source files parse; referenced HTML IDs resolve in source; grade reveal year-4 CLEAR now checks compulsory backlog and placement failure.
ai_audit.v060_random_drafts: PASS mock DOM: 450 year-end choice sequences (3 faculties × 5 activities × 10 seeds × 3 school years): 450/450 showed three unique skill buttons, 450/450 selections progressed to the next semester, no exceptions. Job-hour skill appears only for job/combo; club retirement only for club/combo.
ai_audit.v060_skill_effects: PASS targeted: club retirement reduced 3 meeting slots to 0, tutoring wage raise reduced 4 to 3, past exams added 5pp to pass chance (71% to 76%), score boosting added 10% points (200pt to 220pt), and a feasible compulsory pre-class preparation reservation gave exactly 100% pass chance.
ai_audit.v060_grade: PASS mock DOM: 75 cheating-year term probes: 6 detections => six forced GAME OVER; 69 no detections; 0 errors. 40 year-four petition scenarios: 40 presented petition choices, 6 first-attempt successes and 34 failures with saved deterministic results; 0 exceptions. All-pass and all-fail grade banner cases validated.
ai_audit.v060_full_runs: PASS: 150 automatic full-term seeded strategy playthroughs (3 faculties × 5 activities × 10 seeds) terminated correctly, with 177 random yearly skill choices, 60 petitioner interactions, 21 cheating disqualifications, 100 early-year credit-gate failures, and no JS exceptions, mandatory/activity overlaps, or negative scores. This is not an actual browser test or a human success-rate evaluation.
ai_audit.v060_source: PASS: existing JS parsed in source-level checks; HTML includes the new skill, petition, alert, academic-bonus and semester-special IDs. A cross-IIFE playSound ReferenceError discovered during test was fixed by locally-scoped safe audio helper and regression re-tested.
ai_audit.v061_slot_reason: PASS: seven isolated timetable rendering unit cases; no candidates, unmet prerequisites, campus movement, time conflict, extracurricular conflict, mixed eligibility, and available course. Expected labels matched 7/7. All blocked slots remained inert. Not real smartphone/browser QA.

Nonqualifying annual gate suppressed the skill choice. Year-end saved reveal recovers pending draft.
ai_audit.v062_timetable: PASS: mock-DOM time-grid render retained original 42 cell DOM indices and appended one lunch interval row (43rd element); all 15 checked subject grids aligned, including period 3 at grid row 5. The mini result timetable has a separate smaller lunch interval style.
ai_audit.v062_movement: PASS: seven targeted campus-movement situations: 2nd→3rd cross-campus travel uses lunch and does not mark 3rd; 1st→2nd and 3rd→4th adjacency still blocked; 1st→3rd still uses period 2. After last specialist-campus course, any separate return travel may still block the next period unless after second period, preserving the existing movement rule.
ai_audit.v062_goal: PASS mock DOM: year 1 banner showed 'あと16単位' from zero, flipped to goal satisfied when 16 credits confirmed, and year 2 banner showed 15 remaining out of 34 with 19 credits.
ai_audit.v063_chance: PASS: isolated risk formula comparisons: first/second-period adjacency -8pp relative to lunch-separated second/third; second/third lunch adjacency 0pp vs different-day baseline; class before extracurricular +4pp; fourth after vacant third -6pp and after two vacant periods -9pp. Source parses and returns valid percentages.
ai_audit.v063_grade_first: PASS: 180 synthetic faculty×activity×seed grade sequences: annual grades visible before draft 180/180, next-button opens three cards 180/180, skipping blocked 180/180, skill choice proceeds to following year 180/180. Annual below-target gate triggers no skill and ends run.
ai_audit.v063_full_play: PASS: 150 full scripted playthroughs under updated odds, all reached a conclusion without exceptions; 268 manual year-skill prompts and choices, 92 professor petitions, zero required/activity slot overlaps. These are simulated strategy and mocked DOM, not user tests.
ai_audit.v063_resume: PASS: three faculty-specific save/resume fixtures: before opening the draft, resume shows final grades and CTA; after explicitly opening it, resume restores the three cards. 3/3 scenarios passed.
ai_audit.v070_root_cause: CONFIRMED: the next button was assigned an older advance handler in polish.js before year-skills.js wrapped the function. Calling advance() directly in old synthetic tests hid the defect. v0.7.0 binds onclick to the final wrapped dispatcher in the last-loaded registration-flow.js.
ai_audit.v070_click_paths: PASS: 60 mock-DOM full UI-handler sequences (3 faculties x 5 activities x 4 seeds): click registration preview, back/edit, reopen and confirm, grade reveal, click visible next button to show exactly three skill cards, click one card to advance. 60/60 all phases, 0 errors. Uses onclick callbacks, not genuine browser taps.
ai_audit.v070_credits: PASS targeted grade ledger cases: ordinary required 2+elective 2 gives total 4 / elective 2; mandatory 2+elective 4 gives total 6 / elective 4; 4-credit annual elective spring interim = elective 0 and autumn final = elective 4; failed elective = elective 0. Check for each of three faculties.
ai_audit.v070_full_runs: PASS: 120 8-semester scripted strategy runs (3 faculties x 5 activity types x 8 seeds), all 120 ended without exception, 672 registration confirmation and grade sequences, 229 actual click-handler skill selections, 63 professor petitions, 0 mandatory-vs-activity conflicts. Outcomes: 49 failed year elective gates, 42 cheating GAME OVER, 6 graduations, 23 final-year unsuccessful. These reflect artificial scripted strategies, not measured player difficulty.
ai_audit.v070_static: PASS: registration-flow.js source compiles; scripts still use named DOM IDs. Real website opening with local Chromium was blocked by network policy; live Pages and smartphone touch were NOT tested.
ai_audit.v070_final_html: PASS: final HTML reference check after repair: nine scripts loaded exactly once; registration-flow.js was inadvertently listed twice in a draft and the duplicate was removed before final handoff. No duplicated element IDs.
ai_audit.v071_boundary: PASS: 24 direct click-handler boundary scenarios (3 faculties × 4 years × precisely at target or two credits short). At-target years 1–3 enter three-choice skill draft, missing two credits yields the appropriate year-end fail. Year 4 matches graduation success/failure. Year-progress banner displays matching target and remaining credits. 24/24.
ai_audit.v071_strategy: Regression: 60 scripted high-pass-rate greedy four-year strategies with optional enrollment budget 16 credits/semester: 28 cleared year 1, 9 cleared year 2, 1 cleared year 3; no JavaScript exceptions. These are simulated strategies, NOT calibrated first-time human win rates. Further human review advised before further tightening.
ai_audit.v071_ceiling: Reachability upper-bound: 90 artificial runs (3 faculties × 5 activities × 6 seeds) with grades forcibly set to all-pass and optional load up to 22/semester. Year-one elective requirement was reachable in 90/90; year-two in 84/90, year-three in 77/90, fourth-year elective requirement in 72/90 for this greedy enrollment strategy. This does not prove that all real randomized runs are winnable, nor is it a realistic pass rate.
ai_audit.v071_scope: Updated only s8/balance.js threshold source and metadata/README/index version; s8/lunch-ux.js year progress, s8/year-skills.js draft gate, s8/registration-flow.js preview and s8/expansion.js graduation consume window.S8_OPTIONAL_TARGETS dynamically, so no duplicate number to drift.

browser_qa.notes: Logic tests and DOM-event mock only. Actual web browser/page deployment and smartphone UI tests not performed.

Verify the year-end skill selector appears exactly on the new elective goal when pressing 'next year skill' after grade review.
Play one demanding club/job/combo timetable; investigate potentially unreachable years given the mandatory fixed blocks.
Verify fourth-year graduation still requires all compulsory courses as well as the final elective target.
